1445-4871-5256-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5256-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2267-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

3177-5621-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4772-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3322-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
3322-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
3322-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2862-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl
1618-2440-2862-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2862-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

765-774-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Guildless Commons's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-1525-4913-7201.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4913-7201.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Sapling Nursery trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

4083-5356-6899.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Barbed Servitor.
4083-5356-6899.description:
Deal damage to Barbed Servitor.
Barbed Servitor and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Barbed Servitor trigger, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Barbed Servitor instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

560-1274-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-1274-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

2440-4068-7108-7109.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2440-4068-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4068-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

3525-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

4050-5220-6900-6937.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kalastria Highborn, adding {B}.
When Kalastria Highborn dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Kalastria Highborn trigger, causing you to pay {B} to have an opponent lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kalastria Highborn from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kalastria Highborn from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.
4050-5220-6900-6937.notes: If desired, you can sacrifice another Vampire instead of Kalastria Highborn. The Vampire must have a mana value of 2 or less. If it has a mana value of 1 or less, you'll also gain infinite life.

1482-2866-4779-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5231-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5231-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5231-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 3.

2201-2558-5687-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1808-3698-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
1808-3698-6291.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Clue and Thopter enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-631-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-631-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1003-2232-3652-6134.notablePrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana value 0 must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.
1003-2232-3652-6134.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 0 from your hand by paying {0}.
Rendmaw triggers, causing each player to create a tapped 2/2 Bird creature token.
When the Bird enters the battlefield under your control, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a nontoken creature with mana value 0 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

225-1170-4124-5921-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-4124-5921-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4893-5326-5399.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-4893-5326-5399.notablePrerequisites: Pirated Copy has a power of at least 2.
3719-4893-5326-5399.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Pirated Copy and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Pirated Copy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Pirated Copy to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Pirated Copy enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Pirated Copy by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

799-2598-3491-5261.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Resolve the copy of Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Holding priority, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Remand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Remand, returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat each turn.

585-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
585-2257-4508.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, giving Reckless Firweaver the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Unnatural Selection, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2290-3097-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2290-3097-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

543-2021-4772.notablePrerequisites: Colossus of Akros is not monstrous.
543-2021-4772.description:
Activate Colossus of Akros by paying {10}, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to become monstrous.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting forty growth counters on itself.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2146-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

224-280-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
